title: Numerical semiampleness of nef adjoint classes on compact Kähler manifolds

abstractEnglish: Let X be a smooth connected compact Kähler manifold, let B be an effective rational simple normal crossing divisor with coefficients less than one, and let M be a nef rational holomorphic line bundle on X. If $`K_X+B`$ is pseudo-effective and $`K_X+B+M`$ is nef, we prove that its first Chern class in real Bott–Chern cohomology is represented by a semiample rational line bundle. This numerical statement allows a flat change of line bundle; it does not assert semiampleness of the original adjoint.
